title: Bucs safety's fiancée helped woman hit by car

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Bucs safety's fiancée helped woman hit by car
sources.description: Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield Jr.'s fiancée, Teesa Mpagi, rushed to aid a pedestrian struck by a car in front of the friends-and-family bus headed to Saturday's Fanatics Flag Football Classic at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles.
